name: Foal
tips: `--help` after almost any command prints a summary of its options: the fastest way to remember how it works.
`man ls` opens the full manual of `ls`. Press `/` to search inside it and `q` to leave.
Read the help of the tools you use every day: you'll find options you never knew about.
